newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MCCAIN BUILDS WORLD'S BIGGEST FRENCH FRIES FACTORY.
newsitem.headline: MCCAIN BUILDS WORLD'S BIGGEST FRENCH FRIES FACTORY.

text.p: McCain Foods Holland BV, a unit of Canada's McCains Foods Group, said on Tuesday it would build a French fries factory in the Netherlands which would be the biggest in the world.
McCain manager Folkert Sneep said the new factory would produce 25 tonnes of frozen fries per hour. "Annually the plant's output will be some 100.000 tonnes," he said.
The firm said it would invest 57 million guilders in the new factory in the town of Lelystad which will open in October.
"We have chosen to build the factory in this area because of the good agricultural tradition in the Netherlands," he said.
McCain Foods Group employs 12,500 people worldwide and has total annual sales of over four billion Canadian dollars.
